title: A self-playing plucked melody
summary: Use Pam's as clock and random melody source, Maths as the envelope, and Dixie II+ through Ripples for a plucked voice that plays itself, then add space with Beads.
goal: A plucked, in-key melody that plays on its own in time with Pam's, with a granular shimmer behind it.
origin: Example walkthrough that ships with RackApp
youNeed: Headphones or a mixer connected to Veils output 4

patch.note: x2 gate, one pluck per eighth note
x1 gate, one grain per beat

sections.title: Set up the clock and the melody on Pam's
sections.intro: Pam's does two jobs here: it keeps time and it invents the notes.

steps.do: Set the BPM to about **100** and press **Start/Stop**.

steps.why: Two pulses per beat gives you eighth notes.

steps.do: Set **Output 2** to **x2**, **Wave → Random**, **Level** about 40%, and **Quant → Pentatonic Major (PM)**.
steps.why: Quantizing snaps the random voltage to notes that always sound good together.
The random melody now repeats every four beats instead of wandering forever.

sections.title: Make the pluck
sections.intro: Maths turns each gate into a short envelope, and Ripples uses it to open both the filter and the VCA.

steps.do: On Maths channel 1, turn **Rise** fully counter-clockwise and **Fall** to about 10 o'clock.
steps.why: Instant attack with a short decay is what makes it sound plucked.

steps.do: On Dixie II+, pick a middle **Octave** and tune it.
On Ripples, set **Frequency** to about 11 o'clock and **Resonance** to about 10 o'clock. Patch Maths **Ch 1 Unity** into Ripples **FM** as well if you want the filter to move with each note.

sections.note: If it's too clicky, turn Maths Rise up just a touch.

steps.do: Set Beads **Density** to 12 o'clock and **Size** to about 2 o'clock.
steps.why: With SEED clocked from Pam's, each beat triggers a grain.

steps.do: Raise **Feedback** and **Reverb** slowly until the notes bloom.
Bring up Veils channel 1 and listen from **Output 4**.
steps.why: Veils outputs sum down into output 4 when the earlier outputs aren't patched.

troubleshooting.problem: The notes are out of tune with each other
troubleshooting.fix: Check Quant on Pam's Output 2 is not set to NO, and that Dixie II+ tracks properly against a tuner.
Ripples' VCA needs the envelope in LEVEL. Check Maths channel 1 is actually being triggered (its LED should flash).
